name: working-with-wood-and-metal
description: Working with Wood and Metal: the two materials compared, shop safety, reading wood, stock selection and preparation, layout and marking, hand tools, sharpening, machines, the table saw, joinery technique, glue-ups, wood finishing, metal in the shop, what changes when you work metal, marking out, cutting metal, drilling and tapping, manual machining, the welding processes, brazing and soldering, forming and forging, heat treatment, metal finishing, fasteners and fits, measurement, and shop setup with dust and fume control.
